The air was thick with the scent of salt and diesel, a familiar perfume that clung to their clothes and hair. They had worked all day, hoisting containers onto the ships, their muscles aching from the repetitive motion. Now, they were tired, but they were also proud of their work. They had kept the harbour running smoothly, ensuring that the ships could dock and unload their cargo without any delays.
